kevin-sales: Quick heads-up  Prospect: SummitGate wants a 10-day POC. Scope: Okta SSO (SP-initiated), SCIM user+group sync (bulk + delta), RBAC mapping, and domain verification for three subdomains across two DNS providers. They sent our security questionnaire and asked for a Dedicated trial quote. Need fast answers on SCIM throttles, delta vs bulk guidance, domain TXT vs CNAME options, delegated tenant admin capabilities, and what we include in the security packet. @nora-se @liam-eng @ana-ops @tess-legal

nora-se: Ack. High level: SAML SP-initiated supported; IdP metadata URL or XML accepted. SCIM 2.0 supported: bulk import for seeding + PATCH-based delta for incremental updates. Group->role mapping supported with allowlist. Recommend bulk for initial large imports, then delta for steady-state.

liam-eng: SCIM specifics: delta uses PATCH ops and our webhook/delta feed surfaces only changed resources. Default Hosted throttle is 60 req/s for SCIM (can request bump for POC). If they plan large one-time migration use bulk with pageSize ~500-1000 to avoid timeouts. Minimal PATCH example we accept in docs: PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":false}]}

nora-se: Note re: SAML groups: large assertions or nested groups can blow up assertion size; prefer SCIM groups for heavy group sets.

ana-ops: Domain verification: primary method is DNS TXT per (sub)domain. We can sometimes accept CNAME verification for customers who cannot add TXT, but that requires ops approval and is slower. No wildcard apex verification. For subdomains in the same zone we can provide an ops-approved consolidated TXT to reduce records (requires their DNS admin OK). Verification usually clears within minutes after propagation; schedule 24h buffer. We can run verification for them if they provide readonly DNS access or paste the TXT values.

tess-legal: Security packet: SOC2 Type II executive summary, pen-test summary, encryption-at-rest & KMS notes, SAML endpoints + required attributes, SCIM scope/retention, network isolation whitepaper for Dedicated, and our standard DPA. If they return the questionnaire we'll complete and flag any redlines. ISA/DPA negotiation is separate.

kevin-sales: Pricing request: they prefer Dedicated if pricing is reasonable. Rough ballpark for their expected POC load (~150k tokens/day, moderate concurrency)  Dedicated trial estimate $2,700/week; hosted credits + elevated quota is alternative. I'll pull formal quote from sales ops. :moneybag:

calendar-bot: Created event "SummitGate POC kickoff  SSO & SCIM" Fri 9:30 AM (30m) with #sales, @nora-se, @liam-eng, @tess-legal.

kevin-sales: I'll ask them for IdP metadata (XML/URL), a sample SAML assertion, SCIM test token + one test user, list of domains with DNS provider contacts, and their completed questionnaire. Will share quote EOD. :thumbsup:
